description: Soon Pitt Rowing will take on their first Spring regatta at the Knecht Cup in Cherry Hill, New Jersey!
Pitt Rowing will travel to Cherry Hill, New Jersey to race in the Dad Vails Regatta!
In their final regatta of the Spring, Pitt Rowing will hit the water in Oak Ridge, Tennessee for the ACRA National Championship Regatta.
This year for Pitt Day of Giving, we raised over $9000! Thank you so much to everyone who donated!
